jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status\-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.


With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well\-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.


Urgently hiring.
  

This 100%onsite role, serves as the key administrative support team member to the Enrichment Center and supporting other Companioa Programs, this role requires a highly organized and proactive individual to ensure maximum efficiency and streamline operations in a highly dynamic team. Primary duties include supporting client referral to enrollment process, client records compliance, transportation management, supply management, and program coordination.**Prospects, Tours \& Enrollments**

* Maintain a thorough knowledge of all dementia services to communicate Companioa programs effectively and accurately to referral sources, prospects, and other visitors to the Enrichment Center.
* Receive all incoming calls to main line at the Enrichment Center \& provide response within 1 business day.
* Facilitate tours of the Enrichment Center for prospects and referral sources as needed and conduct timely follow up after tour to identify next steps.
* Proactively engage Director as enrollment barriers arise.
* Assist new client / family with Enrichment Center enrollment paperwork.
* Ensure all new clients have a successful transition to designated Companioa programs.
* Assist in completing \& submitting transit applications and supplemental documentation for all impacted new enrollees.

 **Client Records \& Billing Management**

* Maintain daily attendance log with updates, notes, and client\-specific needs.
* Enter client status updates (enrollment, disenrollment, hold, etc.) and notes for all communication with prospects and clients into electronic health record within 2 business days.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records for all funder \& grant contracts using required systems.
* Completely and accurately follow client file checklists to ensure files are complete, current, and in compliance with licensing.
* Manage client roster for Enrichment Center and Care Coaching programs. This includes, providing enrollment and disenrollment information in the client health record and submitting accurate attendance reports to billing department.
* Maintain emergency rosters for all enrolled clients with a minimum of monthly updates.
* Collaborate with program liaisons at Veterans Administration, SF Department of Disability and Aging Services, and other grant/funders as needed.

 **Transportation**

* Manage relationship and requests with outside transit providers, this includes assisting clients with Paratransit enrollment and coordinating requests for Group Van services, including participation in stakeholder meetings.
* Maintain transportation manifests for multiple providers.
* Document unmet and untimely service in internal logs \& communicate with vendors in real time.

 **Supply \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate meal service with outside vendor to ensure accurate count of meals based on forecasted Enrichment Center attendance.
* Maintain adequate stock of program materials and supply and replenish proactively.

 **Other Duties**

* Participate in daily team meetings to inform Enrichment Center staff of the anticipated daily attendance and other details regarding prospects and other visitors.
* Assist Program Director in audit readiness and ongoing monitoring tasks to ensure compliance with state licensing regulations and other service contracts.
* Maintain knowledge of all safety and emergency protocols to effectively direct staff, clients, and visitors.
* Support Enrichment Center programs, including meals and activities, as needed.
* Actively participate in Companioa and IOA meetings.
* Other duties as assigned.

 **EDUCATION:**


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

 **BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Five years of program or administrative experience
* Interest and ability to support older adults, particularly persons with dementia
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain effective relationships with a wide range of internal and external clients
* Team player
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

 **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift 35 lbs
* Ability to reach, bend and walk

 **COMPENSATION:**

**Range:** $ 34 \- 35\.50/hourly

Position Title: Senior Program Manager of Community Partnerships

Department: Community Education \& Partnerships (CEP)

Reports To: Assistant Director of Community Partnerships (CP)

Location: 3450 3rd Street, San Francisco, CA 94124

ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION

Safe \& Sound's mission is to prevent and reduce the impact of childhood abuse, neglect, and trauma. We do this by strengthening families, building communities, and advancing healing, equity, and justice. We envision a future free from childhood trauma, where all children, families, and communities are safe, supported, and loved.

Combining direct services, training and capacity building, research, and advocacy to strengthen families in their communities, address childhood trauma, and prevent abuse, Safe \& Sound has evolved into a premiere child\-serving organization, bringing over 50 years of service to our community.

We reach more than 11,000 caregivers and children annually with our unique coordinated, multi\-generational approach that spans the entire spectrum of prevention and intervention to strengthen family resilience and address factors that put families at risk for experiencing abuse or involvement in unsubstantiated abuse allegations.

The organization has an annual operating budget of approximately $10\.8 million and is supported by approximately 55 staff, interns, and more than 100 volunteers. Safe \& Sound headquarters is located in a historic firehouse in the Haight\-Ashbury neighborhood of San Francisco, with a second office in the Bayview neighborhood.

More information is available at: .

OVERALL SUMMARY

The Senior Program Manager of Community Partnerships is responsible for the day\-to\-day programmatic leadership, implementation, and continuous improvement of SafeStart and Community Bridges, while supporting broader Community Partnerships work and cultivating strong relationships with community partners, funders, and internal stakeholders. Reporting to the Assistant Director of Community Partnerships, this position is responsible for ensuring effective implementation and operations, including coordinating workflows, staffing, deliverables, and partner coordination. Additionally, this position directly supervises Community Bridges and SafeStart staff to provide support and direction for these programs.

The Senior Program Manager develops and maintains strong working relationships with community partners, funders, and internal stakeholders and ensures that SafeStart and Community Bridges are implemented in alignment with Safe \& Sound’s mission, FRCI (Family Resource Center Initiative) expectations, FFPSA (Families First Prevention Services Act) requirements, and Community Pathway practices.

Team Development \& Program Management

* Supervise assigned Community Partnerships staff through regular one\-on\-ones, coaching, performance feedback, goal\-setting, and performance evaluations.
* Support the Program Associate of Community Bridges, Program Associate of SafeStart, and Program Associate of Community Partnerships in carrying out direct service, training, outreach, documentation, and community coordination responsibilities.
* Provide day\-to\-day management and direction for SafeStart and Community Bridges, ensuring that program activities are aligned with Safe \& Sound’s mission, values, strategic goals, and Community Pathway vision.
* Develop, implement, and monitor annual work plans, timelines, staffing plans, and deliverables for assigned Community Partnerships programs in partnership with the Assistant Director of Community Partnerships.
* Foster a collaborative, supportive, and learning\-oriented team culture that emphasizes trauma\-informed practice, strengths\-based practices,equity, accountability, and professional growth.
* Support staff in navigating complex family needs, community partnership work, and cross\-departmental coordination while centering the needs, priorities, and lived experiences of families and communities.

​SafeStart Leadership

* Oversee the SafeStart population\-based Family Resource Center, a collaborative effort that provides community\-based services to families with young children who have been exposed to violence.
* Supervise Safe \& Sound’s SafeStart staff and support the coordination and delivery of referrals, trauma\-informed case management, workshops, events, groups, trainings, and related program activities with partner agencies.
* Organize, attend, and help facilitate SafeStart\-related meetings, including case consultation meetings, policy meetings, trainings, and planning spaces, and communicate relevant learning to internal staff and leadership.
* Help maintain and strengthen relationships with SafeStart partners and other community\-based referral sources in order to support service access and collaboration.

Community Bridges Leadership

* Manage implementation of Community Bridges as a prevention\-focused extension of SafeStart that provides light\-touch case management, family advocacy, and resource navigation for families with young children experiencing concrete needs and family stressors.

jobs.description:
**About the Team****:**

Giants Enterprises creates private events, public programs and memorable hospitality experiences at Oracle Park and beyond. With more than 15 ballpark venues and flexible event spaces, we bring together clients, partners and internal teams to deliver experiences of many sizes, from intimate gatherings to major productions.  


**About the Role****:**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Client Services Manager to lead complex, high touch events from planning through final reconciliation. Reporting to the Director of Events \& Client Services, you will serve as a trusted client partner, own event details and budgets, and coordinate teams across Sales, Operations, Catering, Finance, Scoreboard and other departments. The role requires the judgment to manage VIP expectations and large events with more than 1,000 attendees while maintaining exceptional service and financial discipline.  


**You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because….**
* Lead a portfolio of meetings, receptions, galas, concerts and other events from handoff and planning through on site execution and follow up.
* Serve as the primary client contact, translating goals into clear event plans, anticipating needs and resolving issues with discretion and urgency.
* Build strong relationships with internal teams, clients and external partners to support seamless planning, clear communication and lasting client partnerships.
* Own high touch, large scale events with more than 1,000 attendees, coordinating guest experience, staffing, vendors, catering, production, timelines and venue logistics.
* Build and maintain detailed event budgets and cost sheets in Excel; track estimates, vendor costs, client charges, payments, changes and projected profitability.
* Review event orders, contracts, invoices and cost reports for accuracy; forecast expenses and revenue, flag variances and reconcile financial results after events.
* Partner with Sales to ensure a smooth client transition and identify thoughtful opportunities to expand the event experience and revenue.
* Coordinate internal teams and external vendors, clarify ownership and deadlines, and keep stakeholders informed as plans change.
* Lead on site execution, troubleshoot in real time and uphold venue standards, safety requirements and an exceptional guest experience.
* Capture client and team feedback, recommend process improvements and help strengthen the consistency and efficiency of the department.

* Seven or more years of experience in event management, client services or hospitality, with demonstrated ownership of complex events.
* Proven experience managing high\-touch, large scale events with more than 1,000 attendees. Experience at a stadium, arena, convention center, hotel, resort or comparable venue is strongly preferred.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, financial tracking and the ability to create, maintain and interpret event budgets and cost sheets.
* Strong understanding of event financials, including pricing, cost control, forecasting, billing, reconciliation and event profitability.
* Ability to manage several complex events at once while maintaining careful attention to details, deadlines and client relationships.
* Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment and confidence working with senior clients, partners and cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency with Outlook, Google Workspace and CRM or event management software.
* Ability to work on site at Oracle Park, including evenings and weekends as the event calendar requires. Regular and predictable attendance is required.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, New Verticals - Grocery Merchant Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



Our New Verticals team launched in 2020 with the purpose of delighting our customers and empowering local communities outside of just restaurants. Since then, we've launched Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol, Retail, and DashMarts while also building merchant services, dasher tooling and consumer products. New Verticals is the growth engine of DoorDash's business and we are continuing to build and scale new businesses everyday! Grocery is one of our highest priority, most complex verticals that is key to acquiring consumers to new verticals outside of just restaurants.


**About the Role**
------------------



We are hiring two Associate Manager roles on our Grocery Merchant Strategy \& Operations teams to lead high growth segments of the grocery business \- mid market and local grocery. In this role you will serve as the general manager of your respective segment – the central owner of the end to end merchant and customer experience to make them successful. Your role will include a mix of managing the day to day success of the segment, while also driving long\-range strategic bets that are critical to the portfolio's success. You will partner closely with product, engineering, finance, analytics and sales / business development to bring these initiatives to life!



These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect you to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.



You will be an individual contributor. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **Strategize.** From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace \- dashers, merchants and consumers.
* **Operate**. Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.
* **Analyze**. Build models using spreadsheets, SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments. You'll use AI every day to accelerate and deepen that analysis.
* **Experiment.** You'll transform strategies into operational experiments, product features and net\-new tooling that create measurable outcomes.
* **Build with AI**. You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day\-to\-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
* **Lead, collaborate and Influence.** You'll partner with and influence cross\-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* **You have 4\-6\+ years of experience.** You've succeeded in similar cultures that are highly analytical and cross\-functional (whether in tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience).
* **You are an owner.** You're always looking for opportunities to better your work product and own the outcome – both the good and the bad
* **You're entrepreneurial.** You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.
* **You're analytical.** You let data win arguments, and you're comfortable pulling your own data in SQL and building models in spreadsheets.
* **You solve problems from first principles.** You have a talent for synthesizing complex problems, can translate high\-level goals into actionable plans, and enjoy implementing a process
* **You're equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot.** You don't hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you're just as comfortable thinking long\-term and inspiring a team.
* **You're unafraid of ambiguity.** Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environment
* **You're energized by AI tools** — and you actively experiment with them. You don't wait to be told how to use a new tool; you're already exploring tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini and more. You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.


**You have a completed Bachelor's Degree in a field that builds a mix of quantitative and general critical thinking skills.**



Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. jobs.title: Associate Manager Product Operations, Autonomy Commercialization - DoorDash Dot
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last\-mile logistics in the long term. If you want to work on commercializing autonomy and robotics in a service used by millions of people — and on bringing the merchant partners who power that service along with us — then we want to talk to you!


**About the Role**
------------------



Come help us redefine last\-mile logistics through robotics, automation, and other advanced technologies. Autonomy only works when merchants — restaurants, retailers, and other partners — can reliably interact with our robots: handing off orders, troubleshooting edge cases, and trusting the experience enough to keep using it. This role owns that side of the equation.



We're looking for a Merchant Success \& Growth lead to build the strategy and operational mechanisms that get merchants onboard, keep them performing, and turn their day\-to\-day reality into a tight feedback loop for product and engineering.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Own merchant adoption and performance KPIs for autonomy end\-to\-end — defining what "successful merchant interaction with a robot" means, instrumenting it, and driving improvement against it.
* Build the playbooks and operational mechanisms to onboard merchants to autonomy — from first conversation through training, go\-live, and steady\-state ops — and scale them across markets.
* Partner with sales, account management, and field ops to recruit and ramp the right merchant cohorts for each stage of the product, and design experiments that test new merchant\-facing features and handoff models.
* Define merchant performance benchmarks (handoff success rate, dwell time, dasher/robot interaction quality, merchant CSAT) and run the cadence that holds partners and internal teams accountable to them.
* Stand up the feedback loop from the field back to product and engineering — turning merchant complaints, edge cases, and frontline observations into prioritized inputs that change what we build next.
* Be the voice of the merchant inside Labs: advocating for their constraints in product reviews, roadmap planning, and launch decisions.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You have a Bachelor's degree in business, operations, or a related field, or equivalent related experience.
* You have 3–6 years of experience in Strategy \& Operations, Merchant/Partner Success, Product Operations, Business Strategy, or a closely related field — ideally with time spent owning a partner\-facing KPI end\-to\-end.
* You've built operational mechanisms from scratch — onboarding flows, performance reviews, escalation paths, feedback loops — not just run mechanisms someone else designed.
* You're comfortable in the field. You'll spend time with merchants and on\-the\-ground ops teams, and you treat that as a feature, not a bug.
* You think in metrics. You can define a KPI, instrument it, and tell the difference between a real signal and noise.
* You communicate clearly across audiences — translating frontline merchant pain into crisp product asks, and translating product/engineering tradeoffs back into language merchants and field teams understand.
* You're biased toward action in ambiguous, early\-stage environments. You're energized by problems that don't yet have an owner or a process.
* Bonus: experience launching new technology, hardware, or operationally complex products with external partners.

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.description:

The operational Manager oversees the daily operations of the Housekeeping and Maintenance departments, ensuring the hotel maintains the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, and functionality, This role is responsible for protecting hotel assets through preventive maintenance, leading high performing teams, and supporting guest satisfaction initiatives.


The Operations Manager champions WS Management's commitment to Outrageous Hospitality, core values, and the three P Philosophy:

**People:** Support and develop team members through effective leadership and coaching.

**Planet:** Promote sustainable and efficient operational practices

**Profit:** Protect hotel assets and optimize labor and operational expenses.


This position serves as a Manager\-On\-Duty and may act as the General Manager's representative when necessary.

**Key responsibilities**

**Housekeeping LeadershipQuality Assurance**

Oversee daily housekeeping operations, room readiness, inspections, and cleaning standards.


Ensure all guest rooms, public areas, and back\-of\-house spaces meet or exceed brand standards


Manage scheduling staffing levels, training, coaching, and performance management for Housekeeping team members.


Partner closely with Front Desk leadership to ensure room status accuracy and efficient room turnover.


Conduct regular quality inspections and implement corrective action plans when necessary.

**MaintenanceAsset Management**


Lead preventative maintenance programs and ensure timely completion of work orders.


Maintain building systems including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and life\-safety equipment


Perform regular property inspections to identify maintenance, safety, and appearance concerns.


Coordinate vender services, repairs, and approval capital improvement projects


Protect hotel assets through proactive maintenance and repair planning

**Safety, ComplianceRisk Management**


Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, company policies, and fire\-life\-safety standards


Oversee proper chemical handling, MSDS compliance, and equipment safety procedures,


Maintain accurate inspection records, logs, and compliance documentation


Respond professionally and effectively to emergencies and operational incidents


Promote a culture of workplace safety and accountability

**Qualifications**


Minimum 3 years of hotel operations, housekeeping, maintenance, or facilities management leadership experience


Proven experience leading and developing teams in a hospitality environment


Strong understanding of hotel operations, cleanliness standards, and preventative maintenance programs.


Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and general building systems


Experience managing labor costs, departmental budgets, and inventory controls


Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills


Proficiency with hotel property management systems and Microsoft Office applications


Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.


This statement listed are intended to represent the key duties and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be all responsibilities or qualifications of the job. Due to the cyclical nature of the hospitality industry, employees may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the hotel. We are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and make employment decisions without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, gender, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or other protected class. Those who are ineligible to work in the United States will not be considered.

jobs.title: Manager, People Operations
jobs.description:
Manager, People Operations


The Landline Company (landlineco.com) is revolutionizing air travel by bridging the gap between regional communities and major airline hubs. We partner with top airlines like American, Air Canada, Delta, and Jet Blue to offer innovative multimodal connections across North America. We’ve launched a first of its kind remote terminal checkpoint to expand the reach of major metro airports into local neighborhood checkpoints. Our luxury motorcoaches replace short flights with a faster, more sustainable alternative—reducing costs, addressing pilot shortages, and enhancing passenger journeys.


Job Type: Full\-time, Exempt


Salary: 86,000 – 91,000


The Role:  

We are looking for a Manager, People Operations to be a driver of our People Operations function across the U.S. and Canada. Reporting to the Director of People Operations, you’ll personally handle employee relations, investigations, promotions, corrective actions, new market launches, separations, leaves, and legal compliance, while keeping payroll, benefits, and employee records accurate and up to date. This is an individual contributor and people leader who loves being close to the work, takes pride in getting the details right, and wants to help bring our People strategy to life.


What You'll Do:

* Work closely with the Director and SVP of People to carry out company priorities, flag trends and risks, and recommend improvements to policies and processes based on what you see day to day.
* Serve as a key point of contact for employee relations matters, handling concerns and conducting thorough, impartial workplace investigations from intake through resolution, and escalating complex matters to the Director as needed.
* Partner with front line station leadership and business support team managers on performance issues, promotions, corrective action, and performance management.
* Manage the full separation process from termination conversations, severance memos (preparation, distribution, and filing), and system updates.
* Administer leaves of absence and FMLA, and manage workers’ compensation claims in the U.S. and Canada.
* Handle day\-to\-day compliance work, including I\-9s, responding to unemployment claims and letters, and processing child support and wage garnishment orders using tools like ADP SmartCompliance and E\-Verify.
* Function as an owner of our HRIS ADP WorkforceNow and process pay adjustments (pay differentials, bonuses, missing hours, pto, etc.) and troubleshoot ADP issues alongside our ADP \& Payroll Administrator.
* Process system and benefit enrollments, edits, and terminations, answer employee benefits questions.
* Prepare internal promotions, employment verifications, transfers, and cover employee onboarding as our backup.
* Maintain accurate, confidential employee records, including saving signed Adobe documents and thoroughly documenting employee relations events and actions in employee files.
* Support employee engagement initiatives remotely and in person and help carry out programs that strengthen culture and retention across a distributed workforce based in ON, QC, CA, IL, IN, MA, CO, PA, NJ, DE, NY, and more.
* Serve as a system administrator for People Operations requests and manage employee programs such as uniforms, training, travel, etc.
* Manage and develop our People Operations Coordinator associate.
* Support existing safety plans for our stations and teams in partnership with Operations.


What We’re Looking For:

* 7\+ years of progressive experience in human resources or people operations, including at least 3 years focused on employee relations, investigations, and compliance in a frontline non\-exempt environment
* Experience in people management with a hands\-on, execution\-focused approach and the organization to manage a high volume of work and competing deadlines
* Strong working knowledge of U.S. employment law (FMLA, I\-9, workers’ compensation, unemployment); experience with Canadian and Québec requirements (including CNESST) strongly preferred
* Proven experience conducting workplace investigations and leading difficult conversations, including corrective actions, terminations, and layoffs
* Preferred experience with ADP WorkforceNow, Adobe, Microsoft, Slack, and Zendesk
* Excellent judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential matters
* Experience supporting a multi\-state or multi\-country hourly/frontline workforce, ideally in transportation, aviation, or hospitality
* French language proficiency and PHR/SPHR or SHRM\-CP/SCP certification a plus


Perks \& Benefits:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Paid time off
* Flight benefits through our airline partners
* Company\-paid life insurance


Location:  

Remote, with up to 30% travel to station locations in the USA / Canada with a preference for candidates based in San Francisco, CA, Boston, MA, Philadelphia, PA, Chicago, IL, NYC, NY, Denver, CO.


Schedule:  

Standard business hours local time Monday – Friday  

  

The Landline Company is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Lead Program Manager, Global Infrastructure and Energy, Commercial and Business Operations
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* 5 years of experience in a leadership role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 15 years of experience in program management, business operations, or business process engineering.
* Experience in data analysis, utilizing metrics to track business performance and drive strategic decision\-making.
* Experience in stakeholder management and developing communication strategies across cross\-functional teams.
* Experience translating complex commercial datasets into strategic frameworks and actionable recommendations.
* Experience managing commercial operations, cost benchmarking, or deal governance for large\-scale infrastructure, corporate real estate, or capital projects.
* Experience leading change management initiatives, including the global deployment and adoption of enterprise asset management or operational tools.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Global Infrastructure and Energy organization is responsible to deliver the infrastructure to host and connect every machine and every user on the internet, with Carbon Free Energy (CFE). As part of the Commercial \& Business Operations arm within the Global Operations for Assets and Tooling team, we are responsible to help leadership run the business, and support the strategic negotiators land deals quickly and be able to maximize our returns.


As a Commercial and Business Operations Manager, you will lead critical initiatives that streamline our business operations and drive commercial success. You will act as a strategic partner to business leaders, identifying areas for operational improvement, designing scalable solutions, and leading cross\-functional teams to execute them. This role requires a unique blend of strategic thinking, analytical excellence, and strong program management skills to navigate complex business challenges.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $188000 \- $274000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and maintain operational dashboards. Analyze complex data sets to uncover commercial trends, track performance against targets, and provide actionable recommendations to executive stakeholders.
* Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in current commercial workflows. Design, implement, and scale standardized processes that improve productivity, reduce risk, and accelerate deal velocity.
* Drive alignment across various teams to ensure seamless execution of commercial initiatives. Manage complex programs from inception to delivery.
* Lead the rollout of new tools, systems, and operational frameworks. Ensure comprehensive training and high adoption rates across global teams.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:

We are looking for a Supply Chain Operations Manager within Low Voltage Electronics team to drive cutting edge technologies across all our vehicles and deliver results in a highly innovative and fast paced environment. This position will focus on mapping all component material flows globally for each active project working with external vendors and internal partners, develop robust material pipelining strategies across multiple products and vendors to mitigate E\&O and ensure supply availability. In addition, the person may lead Cost and Capex tracking across all components, programs and vendors within the value chain. An ideal candidate will have high ambition to grow within Tesla and bring high energy/impact to succeed in a fast\-paced environment. Demonstrated ability to successfully navigate through ambiguities/difficult obstacles through collection of facts \& data, advanced planning, evaluation of alternatives, open\-mindedness, thought\-through strategy, and superior communications to lead cross\-functional organizations through sourcing activities.  

**What You'll Do*** Own the Supplier Operations function within the Low Voltage Electronics Supply Chain team, maximizing component supply availability at optimal cost
* Manage material availability, readiness, and visibility across all in\-production programs from development and production ramp through End of Life and Service
* Develop and maintain a Material Drive strategy to ensure appropriate buffer and flexibility at the component level, enabling quick response to demand changes
* Drive cross\-functional alignment on PRQ priorities and material allocation across sites and programs to optimize supply chain efficiency
* Create dashboards and action plans to resolve material shortages in collaboration with GSMs, Vendors, Planning, and SIE teams
* Manage execution with external partners — including component vendors, contract manufacturers, and distributors — serving as the escalation point for urgent and critical issues
* Develop and maintain a Cost Tracker for real\-time cost visibility and opportunity identification; success measured by improved efficiency, supply availability, liability mitigation, and cost transparency
  

**What You'll Bring*** 5\+ years of experience in Supply Chain hardware operations within a fast\-paced, high\-volume industry
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills to manage complexity across multiple manufacturing sites, SKU mixes, and multi\-tier Supply Chain management
* Proven experience managing high\-volume hardware component product launches, delivery, and on\-time execution
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships and drive alignment and collaboration with cross\-functional teams internally and externally, including Engineering and Product Management, to optimize technical specifications and feature vs. value trade\-offs
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including presenting to management and teammates periodically
* Experience developing cost data, models, and analytics independently or partnering with IT teams to design and scale tools and systems for efficiency improvement
* Degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Creative Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


Must be based in the United States.


**About Nen Creative**
----------------------


Nen Creative partners with tech startups to launch bold ideas into the world, creating the brands and stories that fuel their growth.


Since 2022, we've partnered with some of the world's top founders and institutions, including Amazon, Andreessen Horowitz, Cursor, Mercor, Listen Labs, Tech Week, Cartesia, and many more.


We're growing quickly and looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company alongside us.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a **Creative Operations Manager** to own staffing, capacity planning, and resource operations across our creative studio.


You'll work closely with Creative Producers, creative leads, and company leadership to make sure every project has the right team in place at the right time. You'll maintain a clear view across active and upcoming work, identify capacity constraints and scheduling conflicts, and help the studio make better staffing decisions as priorities shift.


A major part of this role is resource management, but you'll also help improve the systems and workflows behind how our studio operates. As we grow, you'll identify where our processes are breaking down and build better ways to plan, staff, track, and coordinate creative work.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who is exceptionally organized, proactive, and excited by both solving today's scheduling problems and building better systems for tomorrow.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Resource \& Capacity Management**

* Own resource planning across all active and upcoming creative projects
* Maintain a clear, up\-to\-date view of team availability, workload, project schedules, and upcoming capacity
* Identify capacity gaps, scheduling conflicts, and potential bottlenecks before they become problems
* Track utilization and help leadership understand where the team is over\- or under\-capacity
* Anticipate future resource needs based on the studio's pipeline and upcoming work

### **Project Staffing \& Scheduling**

* Match projects with the right internal team members based on skills, experience, availability, and project needs
* Partner with Creative Producers and creative leads to understand staffing needs and build the right project teams
* Support staffing for new business opportunities and incoming projects before work kicks off
* Manage staffing changes as project scopes, timelines, and priorities shift
* Coordinate internal staffing across shoots and maintain visibility into the studio\-wide shoot calendar

### **Creative Operations \& Systems**

* Build and maintain the systems, trackers, and dashboards used for resource and project planning
* Improve how projects are planned, staffed, kicked off, tracked, and handed off across the studio
* Identify recurring bottlenecks or operational issues and develop practical solutions
* Create clearer, more consistent processes for Creative Producers and creative teams
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work and reduce unnecessary coordination
* Help leadership understand the operational impact of upcoming work before commitments are made

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in creative operations, resource management, project coordination, creative production, or a related field
* Strong understanding of creative production workflows, including pre\-production, shoot execution, and post\-production
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail
* Naturally proactive — you see potential problems before someone has to point them out
* Strong people skills and the ability to build trust with creatives, project leads, and leadership
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and constantly changing timelines
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Able to make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information
* Resourceful, persistent, and comfortable working without a rigid playbook
* Comfortable with spreadsheets, project management tools, and quick to learn new systems
* Naturally interested in finding better ways for teams to work

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* Play a central role in how a fast\-growing creative studio operates
* Work across a wide range of production projects for ambitious technology companies
* Help build the staffing, planning, and operational systems the company will use as it scales
* Work closely with Creative Producers, creative leadership, and company leadership
* Take ownership of an important function with visibility across the entire studio
* Remote\-friendly, flexible, and entrepreneurial environment
* Healthcare coverage, PTO, and company holidays

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

SP\+, a Metropolis company, is an artificial intelligence company for the real world. We use computer vision to enable checkout\-free parking experiences. So there’s no fumbling with tickets, machines, apps, or credit cards. You just “drive in and drive out.”  

We are the largest parking network in America, with over 23,000 employees powering mobility at over 4,000 locations across North America and Europe.  

Today, we are reinventing parking. Because it’s important, it's everywhere and impacts everyone. Tomorrow, we will power checkout\-free experiences anywhere you go to make the everyday experiences of living, working, and playing remarkable \- giving us back our most valuable asset, time.  


Responsibilities:
**What you’ll do*** Deliver on our Promise by ensuring every moment matters for our clients by resolving client requests and concerns efficiently and communicating proactively with clients on how to improve our operations.
* Hire, develop, train, and supervise a diverse team of Promise\-driven employees. Identify proper staffing levels to complete duties, deliver a superior customer experience, and perform daily job functions.
* Ensure that proper parking, security, and cash control procedures are followed.
* Maximize profitability through revenue development, facility marketing, cash control procedures, expense reviews, and managing the operation's budget.
* Identify all procurement and vendor service needs of the location.
* Perform general accounting duties such as accounts payable, payroll, and petty cash.
* Monitor facility maintenance for cleanliness standards.
* Monitor and review all damage claims. Recommend and implement plans or programs to improve the safety of operations to prevent the occurrence or reoccurrence of similar claims.
* Implement all policies and procedures to ensure compliance with all OSHA laws.


Qualifications:
**What you need*** Demonstrates ability to lead, manage and motivate a diverse group of team members.
* Passionate about going above and beyond to deliver the best possible customer experience and client satisfaction by finding unique ways to solve problems.
* Prior experience developing budgets and P\&L (Profit and Loss) review a plus.
* Ability to react and problem\-solve quickly.
* Experience using various computer applications/systems (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite). Ability to learn internal computer programs.

jobs.title: CCAC Regional Supervisor - Operations & Onboarding Support
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


Location: Remote (California\-based required). Preference for Sacramento, Fresno, and Stockton areas  

Reports to: Program Manager, California Climate Action Corps  

Status: Full\-Time, Exempt  

Salary: $83,300–$89,100 annually (DOE)  

Start Date: Open until filled

  

Benefits:

* 3\+ weeks vacation
* 14 paid holidays \+ additional sick leave
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and mental health coverage
* 403(b) retirement plan
* Annual career development funds
* Remote position, but occasional travel throughout California expected

**About California Climate Action Corps (CCAC)**
------------------------------------------------


California Climate Action Corps (CCAC), a state service program led by California Volunteers, Office of the Governor, and implemented by Bay Area Community Resources (BACR), mobilizes emerging leaders to take direct climate action in communities across California. With over 400 fellows and 100\+ host partners, CCAC supports impactful service projects focused on urban greening, organic waste and edible food recovery, wildfire resiliency, and climate education and volunteer engagement. The program is rooted in service, equity, and sustainability.

### **Position Summary**


The Regional Supervisor – Operations \& Onboarding is a dynamic, multifaceted role responsible for both regional fellowship support and critical program operations for the California Climate Action Corps (CCAC). Approximately half of the role focuses on serving as a Regional Supervisor for a cohort of Fellows and Host Partners, while the other half focuses on owning key administrative, financial, compliance, and operational processes that support a 400\+ Fellow, 100\+ Host Partner Fellowship.


As a Regional Supervisor, this position serves as a primary program liaison across multiple Host Partner sites, providing ongoing support to Fellows and their Site Supervisors, conducting monthly virtual check\-ins and bi\-annual in\-person visits, supporting professional development, and helping ensure a successful Fellowship experience. On the operations side, this position will own high\-volume, detail\-oriented processes including timecard administration, reimbursements, financial reporting, and offer support for onboarding and offboarding, compliance tracking, and audits.

  

This role requires someone who can zoom in on the details while keeping the big picture in view. The ideal candidate is a proactive and organized self\-starter who takes ownership of complex processes, effectively manages competing priorities, and thrives in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Operations \& Finance**

* Own and manage the fellowship timecard approval process and reporting for 400\+ fellows, including reviewing, tracking, and resolving timecard issues
* Manage fellowship reimbursements, review documentation for accuracy and compliance, and coordinate timely processing
* Organize, prepare, and submit financial reports, ensuring information is accurate, complete, and submitted by required deadlines
* Coordinate key onboarding and offboarding processes for 400\+ fellows annually
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems and processes, taking initiative to create greater consistency, efficiency, and accountability
* Support program audits by maintaining organized records, gathering documentation, and responding to requests

### **Fellow Regional Supervision**

* Support the professional development of each AmeriCorps Fellow
* Help facilitate and plan member development training days, community building, and celebrations
* Act as Regional Supervisor for fellows and host partners, meeting virtually on a monthly basis and occasionally conducting in\-person site visits
* Collect all member evaluation and metrics reporting documentation
* Oversee and approve AmeriCorps timesheets, track AmeriCorps hours, and support fellow professional development and post\-fellowship transition

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree and 3\+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
	+ Program or operations administration
	+ Finance, financial administration, or grant administration
	+ Compliance, reporting, or audit support
	+ Onboarding or human resources support
	+ Stakeholder or partnership coordination
	+ Nonprofit, AmeriCorps, or other service\-oriented programs
* A highly organized, detail\-oriented self\-starter who can take ownership of complex processes from start to finish, manage high\-volume work and competing priorities, and maintain accuracy across multiple systems
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues, navigate challenging conversations, balance competing needs, and follow through
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to provide guidance and support to Fellows, Host Partners, and internal team members
* Adaptability and resilience in a fast\-moving environment, with the ability to adjust to changing program needs and priorities
* Strong remote\-work skills, including proactive communication, accountability, and responsiveness
* Experience with project management, reporting, Salesforce, Slack, Google Suite, or the ability to learn new systems quickly
* Experience with sustainability, environmental, or AmeriCorps programs, and familiarity with California environmental policy is a plus

**About Bay Area Community Resources**
--------------------------------------


Bay Area Community Resources (BACR) promotes the healthy development of individuals, families, and communities through direct services, volunteerism, and partnerships in California. Bay Area Community Resources is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Visit our website at www.bacr.org.

jobs.title: Operations Manager - Newark, CA
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer\-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data\-driven decisions and analytical problem\-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.
  

  

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile \- where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile \- where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile \- when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.
  

  

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:
  

* Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
* Lead large\-scope projects with site and regional impact
* Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)


Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.  

  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1\+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* Experience managing a team of 2\+ salaried employees and 70\+ indirect employees
* Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
* Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
* Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
* Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
* Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Senior Project Manager\- Personal Electronics**
=================================================


**The Group:**
--------------


**The charter of ADI’s Personal Electronics (PES) team is to lead the market in selected technology domains with highly differentiated sensing, signal processing and power solutions. Today these technology areas include Audio, Battery Management and Power which drive major growth in our portable Consumer business. With a goal to deliver sustainable growth the PES group will present the successful candidate with a great opportunity for continuous career development as part of a highly motivated and supportive team.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

  

**The Position:**
-----------------


The PES product technology group is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead teams working on the development of new product solutions for next generation portable product applications. The successful candidate will lead project development teams taking responsibility for planning, execution, and delivery from product initiation through to release of the final solution in volume to the customer.

* Co\-ordinate with key project stakeholders to define the scope, full factory cost and total development cost targets for each project plan.

* Track and record in PLE the performance of the project to key milestones.

* Work directly and closely with key customers as required, scheduling and chairing regular meetings and delivering project updates as necessary.

The ideal candidate must be self\-motivated, dynamic, meticulous, prepared to take the initiative and also exhibit the following skills:


* Ideally have 10\+ years’ experience in an Engineering Project/Program Manager role working with large multinational companies
* Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or equivalent

We are one of the fastest\-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 15 rankings in ENR. With over 70 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double\-digit year\-over\-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless!

This individual will manage projects from planning through completion, coordinating with internal stakeholders, design consultants, and vendors to ensure successful execution while minimizing impacts to ongoing operations. The ideal candidate will have experience managing multiple concurrent projects, strong organizational and communication skills, and the ability to effectively navigate complex stakeholder environments. Must have R\&D lab and cleanroom experience with strong knowledge of MEP systems. Experience supporting infrastructure, technology, or mission\-critical facilities is preferred.

* Develop and lead design management, procurement strategies, construction, fit\-out, and closeout.

* Budget development and management.
* Ability to run larger, more complex projects.

* Lead the vision for project procedures and processes for running the project.
* Other duties as assigned.
* Attendance at work during normal business hours.
  

  

**Knowledge \& Skills Required:**

* Knowledge and experience planning, managing \& coordinating all aspects of project, scope and cost for multiple projects.
* Demonstrated ability to monitor and re\-evaluate scope throughout the project and recommend adjustments when necessary.
* Experience collaborating with cost management group to provide accurate and timely cost estimates, cost studies, actual job cost reviews, and budget reconciliation.
* Experience with Value Engineering
* Ability to exercise creativity and resourcefulness in managing the project effectively in a compressed timeframe.
* Utilize effective written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to understand how your role contributes to the organization's goals.
* Deliver quality work product by role modeling organizational core values.
* Hold self accountable to individual and team goals.

* Proactively participate in self\-development to continually enhance current skills and build new skills required to excel at current role and prepare for career progression.
* Demonstrate ability to be dependable, diligent, and thorough.

Education: BS in Construction, CM, Engineering, QS, Architecture, or related field

jobs.title: Staff Product Program Manager, Network Expansion
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.


The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.


At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

 **What we are looking for**


Aurora's commercial trucking network is expanding. By the end of 2026, more than 200 Aurora\-powered trucks will be in driverless commercial operation across multiple freight corridors. Every new lane, endpoint, weigh station, and truck stop must clear software readiness gates spanning map development, ODD analysis, test creation, and on\-road performance before it can carry commercial freight without a driver.


The Staff PM, Network Expansion owns that picture. This role is the primary source of truth for software readiness across all active and upcoming sites, and is responsible for making that state legible to senior leadership, commercial partners, and the engineering teams accountable for closing gaps. The work requires strong technical understanding of the software readiness process, tight coordination across Mapping, Perception, Motion Planning, Systems \& Safety Engineering, and Vehicle Operations, and direct engagement with Business Development and Product Strategy to connect readiness to commercial priorities.


The commercial network will be materially larger in 18 months than it is today. A significant part of this role is building the processes and tooling to scale with it.

**In this role you will**

* **Software Readiness Ownership:** Own the definitive view of where every highway segment, customer endpoint, weigh station, border patrol station, and truck stop stands against software readiness criteria and customer commitments. This spans map development timelines, ODD analysis progress, test creation status, and on\-road performance. Keep this picture current across all active sites and ensure it is the basis for release planning and prioritization decisions.
* **Program Synthesis and Executive Reporting:** Aggregate workstream status across the lane expansion program and produce the executive software readiness update for senior leadership. Own the agenda and content for the weekly program review. Prepare and lead VP\-level decision meetings when major risks require escalation or tradeoffs need to be resolved. The output of this work is senior leadership having an accurate, decision\-ready view of the commercial network at all times.
* **Autonomy Roadmap and Commercial Alignment:** Connect commercial network priorities to autonomy capability development. Partner with Perception, Motion Planning, and Systems \& Safety Engineering to ensure the capability roadmap reflects the lanes and endpoints Aurora needs to open next. Partner with Business Development and Product Strategy to understand which sites carry the highest commercial priority and translate that into concrete input for engineering planning. When workstream slips affect the commercial schedule, articulate the business consequence clearly and identify available tradeoffs.
* **Cross\-Program Execution:** Track and unblock the engineering dependencies that determine when lanes and endpoints are ready to open. Work directly with Motion Planning, Perception, and Systems \& Safety Engineering to understand capability timelines and surface gaps that affect the expansion schedule. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

### **About the Team**


We exist to improve Marketing leaders’ understanding and decision\-making on how to profitably grow the business. Our North Star is to increase pipeline generation by measuring key marketing and financial metrics, inferring actionable insights, catalyzing strategic investment decisions and accelerating operational efficiency across Marketing and Finance.


Our team operates at the intersection of strategy, finance, and marketing execution \- partnering closely with Growth Marketing, Brand \& Creative, Strategic Events, Product Marketing and leadership to ensure that marketing investments are efficient, effective and aligned to Snowflake’s growth priorities.

### **About the Role**


As a strategic finance partner to Snowflake’s Growth Marketing organization, you will own planning, forecasting and performance analyses across a global portfolio of marketing programs, campaigns, and events, and help leaders decide where to invest to drive pipeline and consumption growth. We are looking for a rigorous and driven senior analyst who can work autonomously, bring structure to ambiguous business questions, and influence decisions with clear financial recommendations. You will build trusted relationships with senior marketing leaders, influence decisions with clear financial insights and leverage Snowflake’s own platform to scale existing processes, increase productivity, and sharpen focus on high\-impact strategic work.

### **What You Will Do**


This role will support recurring reporting, own budgeting variance analyses, and help translate data into actionable, clear insights for Marketing stakeholders. You will collaborate closely with senior analysts and cross\-functional partners, developing the skills to navigate ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, and continuously improve processes. This role is ideal for a proactive self\-starter with strong analytical curiosity who wants to strengthen their strategic finance acumen.

### **What You Will Need**

* 4\-7 years of experience in FP\&A, Strategic Finance, Investment Banking, or Consulting, including at least 2 years supporting a GTM organization; ideally at a Saas or consumption\-based company.
* Strong command of funnel metrics and how investments drives pipeline, bookings and consumption
* Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders at all levels
* Proven advanced ability in financial modeling, forecasting, and data analysis to support strategic decision making
* Strong sense of accountability with a proactive, solutions\-oriented approach to learning, improving, and driving work forward
* AI\-first mindset, with track record of using automation or AI to scale reporting and analyses
* Bachelor’s Degree: in Finance, Data Science, Economics, Accounting, or a related field


Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.


How do you want to make your impact?


For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com


The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

* The estimated base salary range for this role is $118,000 \- $155,400\.
* Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.


The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.


To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), cloud technical support, cloud escalation management, or cloud consulting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in a management, technical, or engineering field.
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, problem\-solving, and client management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the successful adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their Google Cloud transformation journey. You'll manage the successful delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services. In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including leadership of enterprises and a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $140000 \- $204000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goal and business transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs in order to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development. Lead across multiple work streams and teams to maintain customer momentum.
* Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand customer’s business, develop strategic roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.
* Plan for customer events and launches, partnering with Support, Engineers, and Site Reliability Engineers to ensure customer success, and work with customers and Support to guide issues/escalations to resolution.
* Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives to scale through partners and accelerate Google Cloud adoption.

* Analytical \& P\&L Acumen: Mastery of data\-backed decision\-making, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and managing operational Support P\&Ls and defect metrics.

jobs.description:
Project Manager Surgical Imaging

Cision Vision \| San Mateo, California \| Full\-time or substantial part\-time

Cision Vision is a MIT spinoff company developing cutting\-edge real\-time, label\-free optical imaging to help surgeons visualize critical anatomy. We are seeking a technically fluent project manager to drive its development across hardware, software, clinical input, quality, and external partners.

The opportunity

Working directly with company and engineering leadership, you will take the surgical imaging program from technological concepts toward a product\-ready system. You will build a credible plan, connect subsystem teams, drive decisions, and make sure progress is demonstrated by working hardware and software and supported by clear documentation. This role calls for someone who can lead through influence and get into the details when needed. Occasional travel to clinical study partners and collaborators is expected.

Responsibilities

* Own an integrated development plan with measurable milestones, owners, dependencies, resources, budget, critical path, and readiness criteria, from requirements and prototype builds through verification and design transfer.
* Coordinate optics and illumination, camera electronics, mechanical engineering, firmware, software, AI, and system integration. Keep subsystem interfaces, build plans, test results, and clinical feedback connected.
* Lead focused technical and program reviews. Identify integration and schedule risks early, drive mitigation and tradeoff decisions, remove blockers, and follow through on commitments.
