jobs.description:
**Description**


**Company Description**
-----------------------

  

The Vertex Companies, LLC (Vertex) is a $180M global consulting firm that integrates strategic advisory, project management, and dispute resolution services for organizations facing complex challenges in a world of risk. We embody our core values of embracing lifelong learning, operating with urgency, maximizing value, and driving collaboration to better outcomes for our clients, colleagues, and communities. Join us if you are looking for a career that offers you a chance to love what you do and deliver meaningful impact.

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

The Senior Consultant II will assist their assigned manager with execution of assigned tasks, lead the production of on time and high\-quality work product, and lead the coordination with other team members as assigned or requested. The Senior Consultant II is responsible for independent creation of technical work product as a single contributor and for supporting the success of their entire assigned practice area as the highest priority, regardless of any assigned subpractice area focus, or specific client engagement or relationship. In any activities, the Senior Consultant II will perform assigned tasks in a manner that models the Company’s core values and inspires and encourages goal achievement through empowerment, learning, and creativity among the team.

  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **Work Product Creation, Project Management, Coordination with Team Members**

* Responsible for supporting assigned manager in meeting or exceeding the defined annual budget for the entire practice area (including proactive creation of work product to meet or exceed defined utilization targets, oversight of execution of profitable technical assignments, and communication with clients as assigned or requested)
* Effectively lead coordination with other team members as requested or assigned, able to provide technical work product review, and monitor own progress on assigned tasks or projects, and ensure work product produced by self is consistently high quality
* Support assigned manager in monitoring of all relevant data related to own performance such as individual utilization rate vs target, client deadlines, accurate and timely timesheet data, etc.
* Meet or exceed defined individual average utilization goals as set forth by company leadership
* Conduct own behavior in a “lead by example” manner, with emphasis on positivity
* Manage own tasks within assigned projects in support of meeting defined objectives and key results (OKRs).
* Travel, as necessary to support client, employee, and leadership needs.
* Perform quality control of all assigned service delivery and self\-generated work product, maintaining an excellent reputation of quality
* Provide feedback to project team leader in a manner that assists with rapid identification and escalation of any client, or technical or operational challenges

### **Operations**

* Be aware of and perform own tasks in a manner that supports the organization’s vision and defined business objectives
* Conduct self and prioritize tasks to work toward achievement of defined profit objectives of assigned projects
* Cooperate in construction of strong cross\-functional teams (support staff assignments of self) to achieve success in shared goals, understanding that multiple perspectives and talents build stronger teams and results
* Complete daily tasks consistent with contract requirements and proactively alert assigned manager to any potential challenges or issues
* Ensure compliance of operations with all local, state and Federal (and International, if applicable) regulations, as well as compliance with company policy
* Ensure consistent high quality on deliverables for all individual work product
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications \& Competencies**
----------------------------------

* Typically requires a Bachelor's degree and 12 years of related experience or a Master's degree and 8 years of related experience.
* Proven track record of independent work product production, communication, and coordination with clients and assigned Supervisor
* Demonstrated knowledge of technical areas

### **Knowledge \& Skills**

* Experience in providing reliable work product review as assigned
* Able to communicate effectively (written and verbal) with co\-workers and Supervisors, and clients, subcontractors, and vendors as assigned
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrated self\-awareness and flexibility in working with a variety of personalities and work styles (colleagues, clients, Assigned Managing Director(s))
* Able to handle multiple priorities and perform consistently and positively under high stress conditions
* Knowledge of computer operations and standard software packages (word processing, spreadsheets, Adobe) required

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

  

At Vertex, we invest in top talent with a highly competitive total compensation package that rewards performance and supports long\-term success. Total compensation includes a base salary and a discretionary variable bonus program, depending on your level. Our comprehensive benefits package offers multiple healthcare and dental plan options, as well as company\-paid Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, and Long\-Term Disability coverage—ensuring peace of mind for you and your family.  

  

We offer a 401(k) plan with immediate matching and full vesting, empowering employees to build financial security from day one. Additional benefits include Flexible Spending Accounts, a robust Employee Assistance Program, and a suite of exclusive perks that enhance everyday life.  

  

Time away matters—so we provide a generous paid time off program, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays (with prorated options for eligible part\-time employees).

jobs.description:
**Must have Technical Physical Security \& Project Management Experience**

**Who We Are**

Telaid is a provider of technology deployments solutions to multi\-site clients. For over 40 years Telaid


has been the technology partner of choice for enterprise clients that want to accelerate technology adoption and drive positive business outcomes through scalable, repeatable programs. Telaid understands the critical need to integrate emerging technologies quickly and precisely. Everything we do is designed to help our customers deploy and manage technologies efficiently and cost effectively. Telaid has an unprecedented ability to execute complex, large scale technology projects on time, and on budget.


**Our Core Values are – Be Proactive,** **Be** **a Team Player, Take Ownership \& Do the Right Thing**

**Summary of Position**


We are looking for a technical professional who possesses project management experience and takes pride in providing superior customer service to our clients, business partners, vendors, and fellow team members. The purpose of this role is to deliver technology deployment projects which meet or exceed Telaid’s goals. This role is responsible for project set up, project execution, financial management, people development and relationship management.

* **Genetec Certification OTC \& STC and Technical Experience working on the Genetec Platform a definite differentiating plus**

Specific key attributes would be experience with:

* Structured cabling – Hands\-on experience with installation, termination, and testing of low\-voltage cabling systems, including Cat5e/Cat6 and fiber optic cabling. Ability to read and interpret cabling diagrams, label and document runs, and ensure installations meet industry standards (e.g., TIA/EIA). Familiarity with patch panels, cable management, and certification testing tools is preferred.
* Networking fundamentals – Solid understanding of IP addressing and subnetting, device\-to\-switch connectivity, structured cabling (copper/fiber), and port configuration/assignments. Ability to troubleshoot basic network connectivity issues and work within enterprise network environments.
* CCTV / Video Surveillance systems – Experience with both analog and IP\-based camera systems, including configuration and management of NVRs. Familiarity with camera manufacturers such as Axis, Hanwha, and Bosch, as well as video management platforms like Genetec. Understanding of camera addressing schemes, bandwidth considerations, and basic system configuration is strongly preferred.
* Intrusion detection systems – Knowledge of intrusion systems including sensors (motion, door/window contacts, glass break), control panels, and alarm devices. Ability to support installation, configuration, and basic troubleshooting of these systems.
* Access Control systems – Experience with access control solutions ranging from standalone electronic keypads to enterprise\-level, networked systems managing multiple sites and buildings. Familiarity with Bosch access control systems is a plus, and relevant Bosch certifications would be beneficial.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

**Project Set Up – Ensures that proper tools are in place prior to the beginning of a project.**

* Develops comprehensive understanding of project strategy and employs this throughout the project set\-up.
* Ensures that there is a schedule in place during project set up that reflects that project strategy and is sufficient to complete project within customers’ expectations.
* Develops, documents, and distributes general conditions in the early phases of project plan based on the project strategy.
* Engages multiple Telaid teams including Onboarding, Engineering, IT, Accounting, Service Delivery, Support Services, and Sales to ensure expectations are clear, roles and responsibilities are set, and project scope is defined.
* Functions as single point of contact to customer for one or many projects. May have specialization by project type (rollout / construction) or technology (security / wireless).
* Coordinates and executes Project Kick off Meetings to understand project scope of work and specific duties and responsibilities for all assigned projects.

**Project Execution – Leads job and team to deliver projects via Telaid’s Proven Process.**

jobs.description:
**Energy Project Solutions (EPS)** is an energy consulting firm that helps partners deliver efficient, high\-value projects through localized expertise and real\-world insight. With more than 500 years of collective experience, our team leads complex energy developments from inception through construction, bringing deep knowledge across engineering, real estate, business development, and finance while leveraging strong relationships with developers, owners, financial institutions, and property owners nationwide.


This is an opportunity to sit at the center of complex energy and infrastructure projects and help turn strategy into execution. As a **Project Manager** within our **Procurement Services** group, you'll play a key role in sourcing, logistics, quality, and material coordination, working cross\-functionally to ensure the right materials, vendors, and processes are in place to support successful project delivery. ------------------

**Who You Are**

* You thrive in fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environments and take ownership without needing heavy direction.

jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Program Manager to lead cross\-team, multi\-vendor coordination that keeps the VA's patient\-generated health data (PGHD) ecosystem running reliably, supporting the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Connected Care. This role oversees delivery across the VA's PGHD applications, Validic's aggregation platform, and emerging integrations such as Google Health, spanning technical alignment, stakeholder management, cross\-team orchestration, and data\-quality oversight. The Program Manager enables national\-scale delivery of device\-derived health data to VA clinicians and Veterans, aligning program goals, stakeholder needs, and technical execution to mission\-critical outcomes. Strong candidates bring program management and Agile delivery experience, plus the ability to navigate complex enterprise healthcare systems.  

This is a fully remote (United States) position and may require up to 10% travel for quarterly reviews.
Responsibilities:

The Program Manager coordinates delivery across multiple products, vendors, and teams in a matrixed environment, supervising staff who may or may not be supporting the work this position functionally oversees. This role aligns efforts across engineering, integration partners, and system owners; manages schedules and status reporting; resolves issues to meet productivity, quality, and client\-satisfaction goals; and monitors progress across the portfolio, stepping in to solve problems with team members and stakeholders. Generally reports to a Senior Program Manager or Portfolio Lead.* Supervise staff in a matrixed environment, including performance oversight, coaching, hiring, and professional development, recognizing that direct reports may or may not support the work this position functionally oversees
* Lead cross\-functional coordination between VA teams, Validic, and third\-party device vendors, aligning priorities, managing issue remediation, and communicating progress across CGM (Abbott, Dexcom), nutrition and sleep data pathways, and new device integrations
* Drive the Google Health API transition across the VA's PGHD applications and pipelines, managing discrepancy tracking, SQA testing follow\-ups, OAuth/CASA approval workflows, and vendor inquiry resolution to keep step, energy\-burned, resting heart rate, and sleep metrics accurate as legacy device APIs sunset
* Coordinate investigation and resolution of data\-quality issues across multiple sources (for example, duplicate CGM records, dropped components in sequential updates, conflicting event ID updates, and observation\-volume drops following SDK changes), synthesizing findings for pipeline teams and Validic engineering
* Facilitate vendor partnerships and support negotiations for new integrations, driving expansion efforts such as new CGM and activity\-data pathways and the API and org\-settings updates they require
* Manage pre\-read and action\-item workflows to ensure productive, well\-prepared coordination sessions, producing pre\-read materials, organizing agendas, and maintaining cross\-team action logs across CGM, device mapping, pipeline fixes, and API transitions
* Oversee alignment across PGHD applications, mobile and web teams, and downstream pipelines, ensuring synchronized release planning, remediation of SQA\-identified issues, correct application of device\-definition rules, and consistent handling of edge cases
* Manage integrated program plans, including risk and status reporting
* Resolve cross\-team blockers and escalate risks to leadership as needed
* Provide oversight of sprint planning, execution, and retrospectives across teams, ensuring they are carried out effectively and meet delivery goals
* Serve as a central liaison across VA digital health programs, collaborating with PGHD governance groups, clinical SMEs, OIT, pipeline engineering, and product teams to maintain unified progress toward national PGHD goals
* Manage vendor and integration partner deliverables, ensuring quality standards are met
* Advise clients on strategic and technical solution options


Qualifications:
**Required Skills and experience**

* Bachelors degree with 12\+ years experience (or commensurate experience)
* Experience supporting federal programs or within the VA/OCC environment
* Familiarity with health data integration platforms such as Validic, or with CGM/remote patient monitoring data (for example, Abbott, Dexcom)
* Experience with health data API transitions or integrations such as Google Health or similar device APIs
* Experience with native mobile (iOS and Android) and web product delivery
* Background working with patient\-generated health data (PGHD) or clinical data sources
* Knowledge of compliance standards, OAuth/CASA workflows, or healthcare\-related systems
* Familiarity with modern tech stacks, APIs, cloud platforms, or DevSecOps
* Experience with backlog tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar
* Experience working with distributed, remote teams

**Clearance required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance.


Posted Salary Range: USD $150,000\.00 \- USD $160,000\.00 /Yr.

The Center for Green Schools (CFGS) is seeking a Regional Program Manager, School Indoor Air Quality Program (Southwest) to support the success of a five\-year, EPA\-funded effort to improve indoor air quality (IAQ) and energy efficiency in K\-12 public school systems.  

In this role, you’ll work closely with the Program Director to build off CFGS’ long\-running and successful models and provide regionally\-relevant training and coaching for K\-12 school system staff to develop plans for cleaner, healthier indoor air and energy efficiency in alignment with USGBC’s mission.

 **Skills*** Strong organizational and project management skills

* Remote, work from home

* Start ASAP – ideally within a few days of accepting the position

* **Minimum 20 hours/week** commitment

* Reliable internet, computer, and a quiet/private calling environment

TheGuarantors is a fintech company helping multifamily owners and operators mitigate leasing risk while expanding access for renters. With a deep understanding of owner, operator, and renter needs, we believe renters deserve better access to the home of their choice and operators deserve greater protection and growth opportunities. That’s why we’re leveraging our real estate expertise and using AI\-driven renter underwriting to help operators qualify renters faster while mitigating the financial risk of renter default. With $7B\+ in lease value protected, we work with 9 of the country’s top 10 operators, are the \#1 lease guarantee provider nationwide, and have consistently been named one of Inc. 5000’s fastest\-growing companies, Forbes’ Best Startup Employers, Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500\.

  

In the **Customer Success Analyst** role, you'll be at the front line of communication with renters, landlords, or brokers, providing vital support to ensure a seamless experience. Whether guiding renters through the application process or helping property managers understand our offerings, you’ll play an essential role in delivering exceptional service. This position requires a strong focus on empathy, clarity, and efficiency, as you’ll address inquiries, resolve issues, and build trust with our customers every step of the way. **What You’ll Do*** Manage a pipeline of deals and proactively follow up with customers in order to move deals forward and drive revenue
* Communicate with customers via phone and email in a wide range of situations that each require a unique approach
* Gather data on customer communications and engagement to fuel our never\-ending quest to improve the user experience

 **What You Bring*** ***Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience***
* ***A roll\-up\-your\-sleeves mentality with excitement to research and learn what you don’t know***
* ***Empathy, integrity, and a sense of humor!***
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Customer\-centric mindset
* Possess a team\-oriented attitude
* Strong math and analytical skills
* Must be able to multitask and be highly adaptable to change
* Ability to work during business hours (8 hour workday between 8 a.m. \- 7 p.m. Eastern Standard Time) and work one weekend day per week with one day off during the week (5\-day work week)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

 **Nice To Have***(Include any skills that would be bonuses to the position, but are not required)** Fluency in an additional language
* ***Prior experience with*** **spreadsheets, data, and technology**
* Experience with communication tools such as Slack and Zoom
* Experience working in a remote environment

 **Benefits**

* Opportunities to make an impact within a fast growing company
* Medical, dental, \& vision insurance, beginning day one
* Health savings account with employer contribution
* Flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, commuter)
* 401(k)
* Generous PTO and paid holidays
* In\-office lunch perk
* Flexible working hours
* Paid parental leave
* Company sponsored short and long term disability

**Base Salary**

**The base salary range is between $50,000 \- $60,000 annually.**


Base salary does not include other forms of compensation or benefits. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location and current market data and may vary from the range above.

  

TheGuarantors is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all.

jobs.title: Channel Account Manager, Partner Sales - VAR Channel
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**  

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80\+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing American companies since 2008\.### **Summary**



Smarsh is seeking a high\-performing Senior Account Manager to drive growth across our Value\-Added Reseller (VAR) ecosystem in the United States. This role sits within our Capture organization and plays a critical part in expanding the reach of Smarsh’s compliance and capture solutions through strategic partner engagement.



Reporting to the Director of Partner Sales – Americas, this individual will be responsible for developing new distribution channels, accelerating partner led revenue, and building a predictable, scalable pipeline. Success in this role requires strong channel leadership, executive engagement, and the ability to align cross\-functional teams to deliver exceptional partner and customer outcomes.



### **How will you contribute?**


* Own and exceed sales quota through VAR partners, driving both new customer acquisition and expansion within existing accounts.
* Develop and execute partner growth strategies to expand distribution and increase market penetration.
* Build and manage a predictable sales pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting and consistent execution.
* Engage and influence partner sales teams, delivering training, enablement, and joint go\-to\-market execution.
* Drive deal lifecycle management, including deal registration, conflict resolution, and opportunity progression.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, supporting partners on customer engagements and solution positioning.
* Lead account planning and mapping initiatives, aligning partner efforts to strategic priorities and high\-value opportunities.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally (Sales, Product, Operations, Finance) to ensure seamless post\-sale execution and customer success.
* Negotiate and manage partner agreements, ensuring profitable and scalable commercial structures.
* Maintain CRM excellence (Salesforce) with accurate forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and communication tracking.
* Support financial accuracy, including partner invoice reconciliation and revenue alignment.
* Deliver product demonstrations and presentations, operating effectively in both sales and technical discussions.
* Build executive\-level relationships within partner organizations to drive long\-term strategic value.
### **What Success looks like...**


* Consistent achievement (and overachievement) of quota through partner\-led sales.
* Expansion of high\-performing VAR relationships and onboarding of new strategic partners.
* Increased partner engagement, enablement, and joint selling effectiveness.
* Seamless collaboration across internal teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
### **What will you bring?**


* Proven success in channel sales, partner management, or indirect sales models, preferably in SaaS, telecom, or compliance solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to build and scale VAR partnerships and drive partner led revenue growth.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels and engage with C\-Suite leaders.
* Experience managing complex sales cycles, negotiations, and partner agreements.
* Proficiency in Salesforce and pipeline management best practices.
* Ability to operate as both a strategic leader and hands\-on contributor in a fast\-paced environment.
* Comfortable presenting and demonstrating solutions in customer and partner settings.
### **What do we offer?**


* Healthcare insurance: We provide medical, dental, and vision insurance, and a flexible spending account that allows you to set aside pre\-tax dollars to pay for eligible out\-of\-pocket expenses.
* Stock options.
* Personal time off: A healthy work\-life balance is critical to your success at the office. Smarsh offers a “take\-what\-you\-need” time off policy as well as flexible work arrangements.
* 401K Match: Smarsh provides a 4% 401K match for which employees are fully vested on day one.
* Sabbatical: The Smarsh sabbatical programme provides a time to recharge, study or simply do something you are passionate about away from the workplace. Employees are eligible after six years of service.
* Recognition: We’re big on kudos for a job well done. Our employee\-recognition programme enables co\-workers to nominate their peers who best embody our core values for recognition.


The above **salary range** represents Smarsh's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible base compensation at the time of posting. ***Any applicable bonus programs will be discussed during the recruiting process.***

The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training.

Local cost of living assessments are done for each new hire at the time of offer.
**About our culture**  

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. jobs.title: Bilingual Dealership Account Manager - Tampa, FL
jobs.description:
Fuel your career with innovation and opportunity! We’re looking for a results\-driven **Dealership Account Manager** in **Tampa, FL** to join our growing field sales team. In this role, you’ll help expand our market reach and build trusted partnerships with dealerships across the region. As a field\-based position, you’ll be on\-site, visiting dealerships daily—connecting with partners, driving growth, and making an impact where it matters most. The role typically follows a six\-day work week, offering hands\-on engagement and the chance to truly own your territory. Bring your passion for auto finance, your drive to succeed, and your commitment to delivering exceptional results.

\*\*\*Residence within or near the assigned geographic territory is required.\*\*\*
### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Prospecting and Business Development:** Identify and engage new dealership partners to expand our network, drive growth, and strengthen market presence in the automotive finance sector.
* **Dealer Support and Relationship Management:** Provide exceptional service and consultative support to dealer partners through on\-site visits to ensure satisfaction, loyalty, and long\-term success.
* **Market Analysis:** Analyze market trends and competitive insights to identify opportunities and guide strategic business decisions.
* **Brand Promotion:** Enhance brand visibility and reputation through targeted outreach, effective communication, and consistent representation of our values and offerings.

### **Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years experience in account management, sales, or business development — ideally within automotive lending, finance, or a related field.
* A consistent record of professional growth, including at least 2 years in your most recent role.
* Hands\-on experience in auto finance or dealership account management; special finance experience is highly valued.
* Willingness and ability to maintain a six\-day work week with daily in\-person visits to dealership partners throughout the territory.
* Strong communicator and negotiator with a proven ability to build trusted relationships and deliver results.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to spot market opportunities and pivot strategies for success.
* Proactive problem\-solver who thrives in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment.
* Familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Collaborative, adaptable, and equally confident working independently.
* Must hold a valid driver’s license, maintain a clean driving record, and carry full coverage insurance.
* Customer\-focused, organized, and committed to excellence in every interaction.
* Must reside within or near the assigned geographic territory.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* Bilingual proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.

Base salary starting at $80,000 plus **uncapped commission/bonus structure** based upon on your performance in generating deal and growing business, providing an OTE of approximately $175,000\.**Why Join Us?**

At Lendbuzz, we value innovation and diversity and are committed to driving success in the automotive industry. As a Dealership Account Manager, you’ll play a key role in our growth and impact in the auto finance space.

**Recent Achievements**

2022 \- Named one of America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes.
2023 \- Received a Fintech Breakthrough award for “Best Consumer Lending Platform” and grew revenue by over 80% year over year.
2024 \- Surpassed ONE MILLION loan applications and counting.

**This Position Includes:**

**Unlimited Earning Potential:** Competitive base salary with uncapped monthly commission and a lucrative bonus structure. Your total compensation will reflect the impact you make in your market.

**Mileage Reimbursement and Company Laptop:** Receive reimbursement for business\-related travel mileage and a company\-issued laptop to support your work.

**Excellent Benefits Package:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on the 1st of the month after your start date, plus 401(k) match and more.

**Unlimited PTO:** Flexibility to manage your own time and schedule, allowing for a work\-life balance.

**Apply Today!** If you’re ready for a challenging and rewarding role as a Dealership Account Manager in **Tampa, FL**, apply now and help us drive success in the automotive industry.

We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. ***A Note on Recruiting Outreach****We’ve been made aware of individuals falsely claiming to represent Lendbuzz using lookalike email addresses (eg @lendbuzzcareers.com). jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Transformation and Product Ops
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.


* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Remote

  
Launched in 2023, **Integrated Services** creates and markets new customer experiences by integrating hardware, software and services across Ford Blue, Model e and Ford Pro. These products and services allow Ford's retail and commercial customers to customize their vehicles like never before with OTA (over\-the\-air)\-driven experiences that grow better over time. Ford is developing leadership at the forefront of connected, digital platforms that will revolutionize every aspect of how vehicles function, the way people interact with them, and the value those vehicles provide.


**In this position...**


As the Group Product Manager, Product Operations and Transformation within Ford Pro Intelligence, you will own one of the most important shifts in how the organization works. To keep its software advantage compounding, Ford Pro is evolving how its product organization plans, operates, and delivers, moving toward a more decentralized and accountable operating model supported by modern ways of working. The aim is to let smaller, empowered teams ship real value faster, while leadership keeps a clear view of progress and tradeoffs across the portfolio. This role makes that shift real on the ground. You will own the new operating model and lead the rhythms that make it stick, build and lead a matrixed product operations function, and set the cadence, metrics, and tooling standards the organization requires. You will also manage the squad(s) that build the shared tools and datasets that no single small team could build on its own.


You will get teams trained, make sure the new process is understood and followed, surface what is working and what is not, and share what works across pods. At the same time, you will give leadership the deliverables a decentralized organization needs, including a coherent view of the roadmap, trustworthy metrics, visible dependencies, and clear executive readouts. This is a high ownership leadership role for someone who sets direction in ambiguity, earns influence by enabling senior product and engineering leaders rather than coordinating or chasing them, and stays close to the detail. Done well, it is the difference between a transformation that sticks and one that fades back to the old way of working.


**What you'll do...**


Matrixed Function Leadership \& Directly Owned Team


* Build, lead, mentor, and develop the product operations and transformation function, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. This is a matrixed role owning processes, tooling, and best practice sharing across squads.
* Own the operating model and portfolio governance as a matrixed function, with the decision rights to set cadence, metrics standards, and tooling standards across squads, backed by a budget.
* Manage the directly owned team (built as needed) creating the shared tools: Conduct reviews, provide regular feedback, and create opportunities for professional growth, including hiring, onboarding, and training.
* Over time this role is expected to morph and increasingly shift into a classic Group Product Manager role, owning the product side of one or more delivery squads, directly applying the learnings and practices consolidated in the product management and transformation side of this role.


Operating Model Transformation
* Drive the rollout of Ford Pro's Domain/Squad operating model, defining best practices for how squads are formed and working with Domain leads to define how ownership, dependencies, and accountability work in a decentralized structure.
* Get deep into team operations so people are trained on the new process, understand it, and are following it, managing the change thoughtfully and with care for how teams experience it.
* Find what is working and what is not across teams, codify best practices, and share them so improvements compound instead of staying trapped in one squad.


AI Intensive Ways of Working
* Support the adoption of AI intensive software and product practices, from AI assisted discovery, competitive research, and customer insight mining to faster, lower cost prototyping and delivery.
* Partner with engineering and product leaders to find where AI skills and agentic workflows can remove overhead. Consolidate existing best practices and build the playbooks and enablement that make those practices repeatable.
* Map AI adoption and delivery to true business value to inform planning and investment decisions and translate it into executive ready narratives and readouts.
* Build toward automating the synthesis and reporting work that is manual today, including feedback aggregation, theme extraction from support tickets and reviews, release notes, experiment summaries, and dashboards.
* Design, deploy, and govern the AI tooling that PMs and builders use, including approved AI prototyping and analysis tools.
* Own the internal knowledge base and context layer that AI agents draw on, so AI gives consistent answers grounded in real Ford Pro data and keep data and instrumentation machine readable and clean enough for agents to operate on.
* Define the guardrails: what can be auto shipped versus what needs review, how AI generated experiments are tracked, and where the data governance and IP and security boundaries sit.


Shared Products, Tooling \& Datasets
* Own the work (and team as needed) that builds and operates shared products, tooling, and datasets no single team would build on its own, treating these as real products with owners, roadmaps, and users.
* Build and maintain reusable, scalable LLM skills and agentic workflows that teams can deploy, rather than each pod reinventing them.

jobs.title: Manager, VSL Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**


The Manager, VSL Customer Success will lead and develop the Customer Success function at Voyager Sopris Learning, building a proactive, scalable, and measurable organization that drives customer outcomes and business results.

  

Reporting to the Director, VSL Customer Success, this role will lead the Customer Success operating model across implementation, adoption, customer health, retention, renewals, and expansion. The Manager will establish clear expectations, processes, performance measures, and accountability across the team while partnering closely with Sales, Product, Professional Learning, Marketing, Operations, and Support.

  

This is a hands\-on leadership role requiring strong people leadership, operational rigor, customer and commercial acumen, data\-informed decision making, and change leadership. The Manager will develop the team and operating model while personally engaging with strategic, high\-value, or complex customer situations when appropriate.

 **Job Responsibilities:**

**Customer Success Strategy \& Operations**

* Translate Customer Success strategy into clear priorities, roles, ownership, processes, and operating rhythms.
* Build scalable practices across implementation, adoption, customer health, retention, renewal, and expansion.
* Establish clear handoffs and accountability across Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, Professional Learning, Product, Support, and Operations.
* Continuously improve processes, systems, and workflows based on customer needs, business priorities, and performance data.

 **Customer Outcomes \& Business Performance**

* Establish and manage customer health practices that identify adoption, risk, opportunity, and intervention needs.
* Develop proactive approaches to implementation, adoption, retention, and renewal.
* Partner with Sales on account strategy, renewals, and qualified expansion opportunities.
* Help the team balance customer advocacy with appropriate commercial and business judgment.
* Monitor trends in retention, renewal, expansion, and customer health and translate insights into action.

 **Strategic \& Complex Customers**

* Personally engage with strategic, high\-value, or complex customers when appropriate.
* Support executive\-level conversations, significant escalations, strategic account planning, and critical retention, adoption, implementation, or expansion opportunities.
* Help resolve complex customer challenges while maintaining clear ownership within the team.

 **Team Leadership \& Change**

* Lead, coach, develop, and hold team members accountable for performance and customer outcomes.
* Establish clear goals, expectations, and performance measures.
* Lead an experienced team through changes in processes, systems, roles, and expectations.
* Address performance concerns directly and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Balance respect for institutional knowledge with the need to evolve how the organization operates.

 **Data, Systems \& Continuous Improvement**

* Establish Customer Success KPIs tied to customer health, adoption, implementation, retention, renewal, expansion, and revenue.
* Ensure consistent and effective use of Salesforce and other Customer Success systems.
* Use data, dashboards, and customer insights to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps.
* Translate data into clear business decisions and actions.
* Improve visibility, data quality, efficiency, and scalability across the function.

 **Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Professional Learning, Marketing, Operations, and Support.
* Establish effective communication, handoffs, escalation paths, and shared accountability.
* Represent Customer Success in cross\-functional planning and decision\-making.
* Surface systemic customer and operational issues and drive sustainable solutions.

The Manager will lead and develop:

* Customer Success Managers
* Strategic Implementation Success Managers
* Strategic District Partners
* Product Enablement \& Analytics Manager

  

The role is accountable for creating an integrated Customer Success organization with clear ownership, consistent operating practices, and measurable performance across the customer lifecycle.

 **Job Requirements:**

* 7\+ years of progressive experience in Customer Success, account management, client services, implementation, or a related customer\-facing function.
* 5\+ years of experience leading and developing teams, with accountability for team performance and customer outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience building or operationalizing Customer Success processes, frameworks, KPIs, and performance practices.
* Experience using CRM systems, customer data, dashboards, and analytics to manage customer health, adoption, retention, renewal, and/or expansion.
* Experience partnering with Sales on renewals, expansion, customer strategy, or revenue opportunities.
* Strong commercial and business acumen with the ability to balance customer needs and business objectives.
* Experience leading teams through organizational, process, or technology change.
* Demonstrated ability to establish accountability and performance expectations within experienced or tenured teams.
* Experience managing complex customer relationships and influencing cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong process and systems orientation with the ability to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* K\-12 or EdTech experience, particularly literacy, mathematics, or intervention.
* Salesforce experience.
* Experience with customer health scoring, churn\-risk management, renewals, or expansion programs.
* Experience building Customer Success dashboards or reporting tied to business performance.
* Experience building or transforming a Customer Success operating model.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Account Manager**  

Department: Sales  

Remote in the United States  

Pay Rate: $60,000 \- $65,000  

Up to 10% Travel  

  

**Company Description:**  

DMD Systems Recovery is on a mission to protect the planet – one IT asset at a time. We help companies securely erase data and give technology a second life through reuse, refurbishment, and responsible recycling. As a certified B Corp, we believe business should do more than make money – it should make a difference. Every laptop, server, and device we process helps reduce waste, shrink landfills, and fuel the next generation of technology. If you care about sustainability, real‑world impact, and smart tech solutions, DMD is a place where your work truly matters.  

  

Our headquarters are in Tempe, Arizona, with additional processing facilities in Austin, Texas and Palo Alto, California.  

  

**Job Summary:**  

The Account Manager is responsible for the retention and growth of designated customer accounts. This is accomplished by acting as the primary point of contact for these customers, ensuring that deliverables align with commitments, and identifying and contracting additional services. This role monitors customer activity, interacts with clients to resolve issues, and provides insights on the best usage of their ITAD program. AM’s work with the tools and data at their disposal to serve as the link between the customer and DMD resulting in improvements to both the client’s ITAD program and services DMD delivers. AM’s are expected to work during regular business hours that meet the needs of the clients they are working with.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:*** **Customer Retention \& Relationship Management:** Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring customer satisfaction, retention, and loyalty through proactive communication, issue resolution, and quality assurance of deliverables.
* **Strategic Planning \& Business Development:** Develop and implement tailored strategies to retain and expand accounts, identify new service opportunities, and present solutions that align with customer objectives.
* **Account Growth \& Revenue Management:** Drive account growth by identifying expansion opportunities, tracking revenue, managing sales pipelines, and optimizing account profitability through analysis of key performance indicators.
* **Business Reviews \& Performance Reporting:** Conduct regular business reviews (ABR/QBR), deliver actionable insights and performance metrics, and prepare detailed reports that demonstrate the value of ITAD services.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with sales, operations, logistics, technical, and marketing teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions and support strategic initiatives.
* **Market Intelligence \& Continuous Improvement:** Stay informed about industry trends and competitors, contribute to process improvements, and foster innovation to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
* **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):** Achieve targets for customer retention, revenue growth, upsell/cross\-sell conversions, timely and high\-quality reporting, issue resolution efficiency, and service/process innovation.
* **Technology Tools:** Comfortable adopting emerging AI tools (such as Microsoft Copilot) to automate routine work, synthesize information, create presentations, and improve decision\-making.

  

**Education and Experience:*** Minimum of 2 years’ experience in Account Management or a Client Success Role.
* CRM, ERP, and Microsoft Office Suite competence required.
* ITAD, Reverse Logistics, or Forward Logistics business experience preferred.
* Experience, education, or interest in Sustainability, Environmental Science, or Recycling preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in business administration preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  

**Physical Requirements:*** Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computers
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at a time.
* Reasonable accommodations will be made, enabling individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

.

.

The Product Operations team is a key part of Twilio’s Super Network, whose mission is to provide the infrastructure that catalogs, orchestrates, and delivers the world's connectivity.

* Provide support for common customer inquiries received by email to ensure they have an excellent experience with Twilio.
* Assess the nature of product or service issues and resolve basic\-to\-intermediate level problems.
* Learn and develop new processes across a variety of subject areas and ensure our operations are running smoothly.
* Respond to and action incoming carrier partner notifications.
* Quickly and confidently triage complex issues to team leads, managers, engineering, or product teams and know which is appropriate in each case.
* Effectively respond to moderately complex questions from customers (external and internal) in core areas and basic questions across multiple areas.
* Work independently to troubleshoot/determine resolution for issues across multiple areas in your team's domain.


**Qualifications**



Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!


**Required:**


* You're thorough, organized, and detail\-oriented, and you’re able to prioritize and execute multiple processes.
* You’re empathetic and customer centric to the core, with experience in customer service.
* You’re a clear verbal and written communicator.
* You are calm under pressure as you respond to escalations and quickly troubleshoot incidents.
* You’re capable of learning quickly and mastering complicated systems.
* You’re capable of working independently but also energized from working within a team and cross\-functionally to achieve the company's goals.
* You’re able to complete tasks in core areas within SLAs.
* You have at least 1 year of experience working on an Operations team.


**Desired:**


* Previous experience in telecommunications.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and related tools


**Location**



This role will be remote, and based in Estonia.


**Travel**



We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in\-person meetings.


**What We Offer**



Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

**Twilio thinks big. Do you?**



We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.



So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.


**.**


**Stay alert to recruitment fraud**



We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Position Overview**

As an Strategic Account Manager, you own the relationship with a portfolio of Momentive clients after the sale. You keep them renewing, help them get more value out of the products they already have, and find the right moments to bring in more of the Momentive portfolio. You are the client’s advocate inside Momentive and Momentive’s trusted partner inside their organization.  



**Position Summary**

You will manage a defined book of existing Momentive clients — associations, nonprofits, and membership organizations — with direct responsibility for retention and expansion of revenue. You will run account reviews, track client health, spot risk early, and build the case for renewal and growth well before a contract is up. You report to the Director, Sales – Account Management and partner daily with Customer Success, Support, and Product to keep clients moving forward with Momentive.  



**A Day in the Life**

* Own a portfolio of existing Momentive clients, serving as their main point of contact after the sale.
* Manage renewals for your accounts start to finish, and catch churn risk early enough to fix it.
* ind and close expansion opportunities — cross\-sell and upsell across the Momentive product portfolio (Aptify, NimbleAMS, GiveSmart, and more).
* Run quarterly business reviews with clients to revisit their goals, show the value delivered, and flag what's next.
* Build and maintain relationships with multiple stakeholders in each account, not just your primary contact.
* Partner with Customer Success and Support so clients get one connected experience instead of a handoff between teams.
* Keep Salesforce current with account plans, renewal dates, opportunity stages, and next steps.
* Track your book against net revenue retention (NRR), renewal rate, and expansion targets, and report on it regularly.
* Bring client feedback back to Momentive — flag themes for Product and Marketing so the roadmap reflects what clients actually need.
* Stay current on the association and nonprofit technology landscape so you can speak to what matters to your clients.
Partner with your Director on account planning, deal strategy, and pipeline reviews for your book.  
* 

  

**We are looking for someone who brings**

**Experience:**

* 3\+ years in account management, customer success, or a client\-facing sales role, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* A track record of meeting or exceeding retention and renewal targets.
* Experience identifying and closing expansion opportunities within an existing account base.
* Comfort managing a portfolio of accounts at once, prioritizing where your time has the most impact.
* Experience navigating accounts with more than one stakeholder or decision\-maker.
* Familiarity with the association, nonprofit, or membership technology space is a plus.

**Technical/Computer Skills:**

* Salesforce, or a comparable CRM, used daily to track accounts, pipeline, and renewals.
* Comfortable with Gong, Salesloft, or similar sales engagement tools.
Microsoft Office 365, including Excel for account and portfolio reporting.  
* 

  

**Other Skills:**

* Strong relationship\-builder who earns trust with clients and keeps it.
* Clear communicator, in writing and in person, with clients and with internal partners.
* Organized enough to manage a full portfolio of accounts without letting renewals sneak up on you.
* Consultative approach: you ask questions and solve problems before you pitch anything.
* Comfortable with numbers — you can read an account's health and explain it in plain terms.
Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients.  
* 

\-  



  

**About Us**
============

  

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose\-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission\-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud\-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com .  

  



**Why Work Here?**
==================

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem\-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager III
jobs.description:
**About Nexcess**


Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission\-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

**Overview**
============


The Technical Account Manager III serves as the highest\-level technical advisor and strategic partner for the organization’s most complex, strategic, or high\-impact customers. This role provides expert guidance on sophisticated hosting environments, long\-term architecture strategy, technical risk, scalability, security, and business continuity.


The TAM III operates with substantial autonomy and organizational influence. This role leads complex customer initiatives and serves as the senior escalation point for critical technical and customer matters.

**Compensation**  

The base salary for this position is between $110k\-$130k plus commission

**Responsibilities**

**Executive and Strategic Customer Partnership**
------------------------------------------------

* Serves as the primary technical authority for the organization’s most complex, strategic, or high\-impact customers.
* Builds trusted relationships with customer executives, technical leaders, and other key stakeholders.
* Develops a comprehensive understanding of customer business models, growth strategies, risk tolerance, and technical objectives.
* Leads executive\-level account reviews, architecture reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
* Influences customer retention, growth, and investment decisions through expert consultation and demonstrated technical value.
* Anticipates evolving customer needs and recommends solutions before they become operational risks.

**Advanced Architecture and Technical Leadership**
--------------------------------------------------

* Leads the assessment and design of highly complex, distributed, or business\-critical hosting environments.
* Provides expert guidance on architecture, performance, security, scalability, resilience, and business continuity.
* Evaluates complex technical dependencies and develops solutions that balance performance, risk, cost, and operational sustainability.
* Establishes technical standards and strategic recommendations for customer environments.
* Reviews and validates technical designs, blueprints, and improvement plans developed by other team members.
* Identifies systemic risks and opportunities affecting multiple customers, platforms, or service offerings.
* Partners with senior Engineering, Product, and Operations leaders on complex customer solutions.

**Critical Initiatives and Escalation Leadership**
--------------------------------------------------

* Leads high\-risk migrations, platform transformations, architecture redesigns, and other complex technical initiatives.
* Serves as a senior escalation point for critical, highly visible, or prolonged customer issues.
* Establishes technical response strategies, ownership, communication expectations, and resolution priorities.
* Coordinates senior technical resources and cross\-functional teams during major customer\-impacting events.
* Communicates complex technical issues, risks, and decisions to customer executives and internal leadership.
* Leads post\-incident and post\-project reviews to identify root causes and organizational improvements.
* Makes recommendations that influence platform, product, service, and operational decisions.

**Team Leadership and Development**
-----------------------------------

* Provides functional leadership, technical direction, coaching, and mentorship to Technical Account Managers.
* Establishes and promotes consistent standards for account strategy, architecture reviews, documentation, and customer engagement.
* Reviews complex customer strategies and provides guidance on technical and relationship risks.
* Leads knowledge\-sharing sessions and develops reusable technical resources, frameworks, and best practices.
* Identifies team capability gaps and recommends training or development opportunities.

**Cross\-Functional Strategy and Continuous Improvement**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Represents strategic customer needs in product, platform, and operational planning.
* Synthesizes customer feedback and technical trends to identify broader service\-improvement opportunities.
* Leads cross\-functional initiatives that improve customer outcomes, internal processes, and technical service delivery.
* Develops scalable frameworks for technical health assessments, architecture reviews, and account planning.
* Partners with Sales and Customer Success on complex opportunities, renewals, and account\-growth strategies.
* Uses portfolio data and customer trends to influence organizational priorities and investment decisions.

**Judgment and Work Management**
--------------------------------

* Exercises advanced independent judgment in matters involving significant technical, customer, financial, or reputational impact.
* Balances customer objectives with technical feasibility, organizational capacity, and long\-term platform strategy.
* Prioritizes work across multiple strategic accounts and complex organizational initiatives.
* Operates with limited oversight and provides recommendations directly to senior leadership.
* Identifies and addresses emerging risks before they affect customer outcomes or business relationships.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* 4\+ years of experience in technical support, technical account management, customer success, systems administration, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience managing proactive technical relationships with customers.
* Bachelor’s degree

jobs.title: Program Leader Global Nav HS
jobs.description:
**Position:** Program Leader – Summer 2027

**Department:** CIEE Global Navigator High School Study Abroad

**Location:** Multiple International Locations; Employment Length: 3, 4, 6, or 8 weeks; Program Dates: Variable, June–August 2027

**To apply to this position, please start your application at** **www.ciee.org/programleaders**


Interested in shaping the global leaders of tomorrow? Next summer, experience the job of a lifetime!

**\*\*Applications submitted via ADP will not be considered unless you first apply at www.ciee.org/programleaders\*\***

**Who we are:**


CIEE is a nonprofit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and multi\-cultural world.

**Why work with us:**

* **You will change the world.** CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high\-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
* **You will be part of a fast\-paced, international, and collaborative team of professionals.** CIEE operates the largest nonprofit network of study abroad locations, with facilities and staff in 30 countries. Additionally, we help international participants from over 140 countries come to the USA each year. Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams and are dedicated to advancing our almost 80\-year\-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

**Who you are**


CIEE Program Leaders (PLs) mentor, supervise, and support high school students participating in summer study abroad programs around the world.


This is a full\-time, residential leadership position with 24/7 availability required throughout the program. Program Leaders are responsible for student safety, well\-being, accountability, and community while helping students navigate the academic, cultural, and personal experiences of living abroad.


Typically, one Program Leader is assigned to every 10–12 students. PLs chaperone group flights and, alongside local CIEE staff and instructors, help oversee the student experience from arrival through departure. The role is demanding and highly responsible, while also providing an opportunity to develop leadership skills, work with young people in an international setting, and help students become more confident, independent, and culturally aware.


The strongest Program Leaders are supportive mentors, confident leaders, and responsible decision\-makers who build trust while setting clear expectations.

 **What you’ll do:**

* Support and mentor students by providing academic, social, emotional, and behavioral support; building positive relationships; and maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
* Monitor student well\-being and safety, responding appropriately to homesickness, culture shock, conflict, medical concerns, behavioral issues, and other challenges in accordance with CIEE protocols.
* Supervise students and program activities, including excursions, travel, daily operations, and scheduled programming while maintaining accountability, attendance, and compliance with program expectations.
* Build an inclusive, culturally responsive community and facilitate reflection and experiential learning beyond the classroom.
* Communicate and collaborate effectively with students, families, instructors, local staff, other Program Leaders, and CIEE colleagues.
* Exercise sound judgment and adaptability, maintaining 24/7 availability, taking initiative, and responding calmly and professionally when challenges arise.

 **This role is a strong fit for someone who:**

* Wants meaningful responsibility and leadership growth. You want to make a difference in students' lives while developing your own leadership skills through real\-world experience.
* Genuinely enjoys being around teenagers. You find satisfaction in mentoring, teaching, coaching, supporting, and spending significant time with young people, including during the less glamorous or more challenging moments.
* Builds strong relationships with clear boundaries. You are approachable and supportive while also setting expectations, holding students accountable, and addressing challenging behavior when necessary.
* Communicates with empathy and professionalism. You listen well, navigate conflict thoughtfully, and communicate effectively with students, families, instructors, local staff, and colleagues.
* Uses sound judgment and stays adaptable under pressure. You can make thoughtful decisions, take initiative, and remain calm and professional when circumstances change or challenges arise.
* Approaches people and cultures with humility and openness. You are curious about different perspectives and committed to youth development, global learning, and creating an inclusive, respectful community.
  

You do not need to have every answer before you arrive. You do need to be willing to learn, ask for help, take responsibility, and keep showing up for your students.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Experience working with high school students in an educational, mentoring, coaching, counseling, or leadership capacity.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Commitment to youth development, global learning, and intercultural exchange.
* Bachelor's degree required.
* Must be 21\+ years of age or older.
* Must be able to travel domestically and internationally.
* Must be able to meet visa and entry requirements for assigned program locations.
* Valid passport through February 2028\.
* Authorization to work in the United States.
* Must pass required background check.
* Must obtain CPR/First Aid certification.
* Language \& Culture programs: Advanced\-Lo

Part\-Time Business Operations Lead \| Executive Coaching \+ Digital Programs

**Remote, U.S.\-Based \| Contract \| 25 Hours/Week \| $40\-$50/Hour**

\*\*\*Note: no need to apply if you haven’t directly ran ops and launches for a coach / digital programs before. Direct experience require.

Evolve is looking for an experienced **Business Operations Lead** to run the day\-to\-day operations of our executive coaching and digital programs business.

I’m looking for someone who has **already done this work**.

You’ve run launches. You understand the moving pieces behind a founder\-led digital business. You know how to take a goal, reverse engineer the plan, coordinate the people and technology, watch the numbers, make decisions, and get it across the finish line.

At Evolve, I lead the business and serve as the visionary and coach. Our Business Development \+ Client Experience lead focuses on growing the business and serving our clients.

**You will run the operating engine behind it.**

You should be the kind of person who looks at what’s coming, reverse engineers what needs to happen, and makes sure I’m fully prepared before I ever have to ask.

What you'll own

* Day\-to\-day business operations, priorities, and operating cadence
* Launch planning, timelines, execution, and post\-launch reviews
* Project management across team members, agencies, contractors, and vendors
* CRM ownership, including understanding what we need from HubSpot and figuring out how to make it happen
* Funnels, email marketing operations, workflows, automations, and customer journeys
* KPI dashboards, reporting, and using data to recommend and make business decisions
* Client and program operations
* Webinars, retreats, events, and digital program execution
* Systems, SOPs, documentation, and continuous process improvement
* Executive calendar oversight and proactive preparation for upcoming priorities
* Making operational decisions and moving work forward without waiting for founder approval on every detail

You do **not** need to personally be an expert HubSpot developer.

You do need to be highly technical and resourceful. If we need HubSpot to do something, I expect you to figure out what needs to happen, learn how to do it, build it, or find the right resource to get it done.

More importantly, you should be able to look at our data and say:

**“Here’s what’s happening, here’s what I think it means, and here’s what I recommend we do next.”**

You need to have run launches before

I’m specifically looking for someone with experience inside a **coaching, consulting, course, membership, digital education, or similar founder\-led business.**

I want someone who has **personally owned and run launches**, not simply been on a team during one.

You should also have experience working with a CRM such as HubSpot and be comfortable learning technology quickly.

Our current tech stack includes HubSpot, Kajabi, Kit, WordPress, Showit, Microsoft 365, Teams, Slack, Zoom, and other digital tools.

You don’t need to know every platform on day one.

You do need to be the person who can figure out almost any platform.

AI is a requirement

You need to be an **early adopter and power user of AI**.

We use ChatGPT, Claude, Wispr Flow, AI agents, automations, scheduled tasks, and other tools to work smarter and faster.

This is not a “willing to learn AI” role.

I’m looking for someone who is already deeply immersed, experimenting with new tools, building bots and automations, creating AI workflows, and constantly asking:

**“How could we do this faster, better, or with less friction?”**

Ideally, you’ll be teaching me things too.

I’m obsessed with efficiency. We don’t do things the way they’ve always been done just because that’s the way they’ve always been done. We’re constantly improving how we operate and figuring out how to get our clients bigger results faster.

The person we're looking for

You are:

* Proactive and highly self\-directed
* Excellent at turning big goals into executable plans
* Comfortable making decisions independently
* Strong with data and business judgment
* Highly organized without needing everything to already be organized
* A clear, professional communicator

Because you’ll work closely with me, there will also be **occasional executive and personal administrative support as needed**, such as calendar coordination, travel, appointments, or other administrative details.

About Evolve

I’m Shayla King, executive coach and founder of Evolve. I help ambitious leaders in corporate America increase their **Performance \+ Happiness**, succeeding at a high level without sacrificing the rest of their lives to do it.

You’ll be joining a team with support across client experience, business development, podcast production, ads, and video.

This is a role with real ownership and autonomy. I want you running the day\-to\-day business, solving problems, improving how we work, and making decisions so I can spend more of my time leading the business, coaching, creating, selling, and doing the work only I can do.

The details

Interested?

Email **careers@evolve\-career.com** with your resume and a short note about why this role interests you.
